name: byj-statusline
description: A status band above the prompt that looks like it shipped with Claude Code: model and effort, session, git, a live context gauge, 5h/7d usage with pace marks, the prompt cache countdown, and a live line of tools, subagents and tasks while Claude works. Hover any part for details; click a name to copy it.

layout.title: Layout
layout.description: auto: one line when everything fits, two lines otherwise. two-line: always two lines (context, then metrics).

icons.title: Icons
icons.description: symbols: a quiet palette, an effort meter, pace marks and single-width glyphs that line up in any terminal. emoji: the original statusline's emoji and traffic-light colours.

details.title: Detail cards on hover
details.description: Rest the pointer on a part of the band for a card with what lies behind it: the context's mix and growth, a window's pace and reset, the git counts spelled out.

activity.title: Activity line
activity.description: While Claude works, a line under the band with the tool running, the turn's tool tally, subagents with their clocks, and task progress. Between turns it stays only for a subagent still running or a task still under way.

cache.title: Prompt cache countdown
cache.description: Between turns, how long until the prompt cache lapses and the next message pays to write the whole context again. The TTL (5 minutes or an hour) is read from the responses.

showCost.title: Show session cost
showCost.description: Add the session's running cost in US dollars to the metrics.

alerts.title: Alert toasts
alerts.description: Raise one toast when the fuel gauge drops below 30%, a usage window passes 90%, or one past half is on pace to run out before it resets.
